args.question: Can you clarify what "Mesh Quality" means exactly? Is it the uvmapqual field (High/Medium/Low), or should it be a derived value like "High Quality"/"Low Quality" based on whether the site has high-fidelity meshes? result: The "Mesh Quality Classification" is a derived value. It's determined by checking if a site has any "High Fidelity Meshes" based on specific criteria (detailed in the "High Fidelity Mesh" ambiguity). If a site has at least one high-fidelity mesh, it's classified as "Has High-Fidelity Meshes". Otherwise, if there are any meshes at all, it's "Standard Mesh Quality". If there are no meshes for a site, it's "No Mesh Data". For numeric values, please round to two decimal places.

args.question: What are the specific criteria for a "High Fidelity Mesh"? Is it simply uvmapqual = 'High', or is there another definition?

SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS side_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * POWER(sm.facetresmm, 2))) * 1000 > 5.0 
             AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 
             AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * POWER(sm.facetresmm, 2))) * 1000 > 5.0 
             AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 
             AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CASE WHEN COUNT(sm.facetregistry) > 0 THEN COUNT(sm.facetregistry) ELSE 1 END, 2) AS proportion_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG((sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * POWER(sm.facetresmm, 2))) * 1000), 2) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    ROUND(AVG(sm.facetresmm), 2) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    ROUND(AVG(sm.geomdeltamm), 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN (sm.facetfaces::numeric / (sm.facetverts::numeric * POWER(sm.facetresmm, 2))) * 1000 > 5.0 
             AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 
             AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes' ELSE 'Standard Mesh Quality' END AS mesh_quality
FROM sites s
JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY proportion_percentage DESC;
